_comment: Relics are DATA (CLAUDE.md §11) — persistent team passives. The good ones CHANGE A RULE rather than nudging a number, and hook this game's own systems (the climb, the grip timer, timed cards, Rhythm, the weak-point threshold). Effect types: max_energy, attack_bonus, round_block, heal_on_clear, start_strength, start_foothold, fall_safe, rhythm_keeps, threshold, chip, sigil_bonus, vuln_bonus, draw, shake_resist, grip_seconds (client), timing_zone (client), block_carries, no_buck, soft_fall, energy_handoff. A relic may also carry 'downside_effect'/'downside_value' — a SECOND {effect, value} pair from the same vocabulary, summed in on top of the first by the identical generic rule (backlog #30) — for a relic that costs something real in exchange for its power. 'pool' lists what can be offered.

old_remedy.name: Old Remedy
old_remedy.text: Recover +8 more HP after each beast falls.

field_kit.name: Field Kit
field_kit.text: Recover +10 more HP after each beast falls.

climbers_boots.name: Climber's Boots
climbers_boots.text: Begin every fight already 1 Height up.

grapple_spurs.name: Grapple Spurs
grapple_spurs.text: Begin every fight already 2 Height up.

feather_harness.name: Feather Harness
feather_harness.text: Losing your grip costs no HP — you only lose the Height.

anchor_pin.name: Anchor Pin
anchor_pin.text: A sweep no longer shakes you down a hold.

chalk_pouch.name: Chalk Pouch
chalk_pouch.text: Your grip holds 2 seconds longer between holds.

tar_gloves.name: Tar Gloves
tar_gloves.text: Your grip holds 4 seconds longer between holds.

drummers_hide.name: Drummer's Hide
drummers_hide.text: Rhythm no longer resets between turns.

deep_hooks.name: Deep Hooks
deep_hooks.text: You may deal 8 more damage at a weak point before it bucks you.

barbed_pitons.name: Barbed Pitons
barbed_pitons.text: You may deal 14 more damage at a weak point before it bucks you.

hunters_mark.name: Hunter's Mark
hunters_mark.text: Each Exposed stack is worth +3 more damage.

prying_bar.name: Prying Bar
prying_bar.text: Armoured hide chips far better — your ground attacks bite.

travellers_stew.name: Traveller's Stew
travellers_stew.text: Recover +14 more HP after each beast falls.

riveted_plates.name: Riveted Plates
riveted_plates.text: Half your unspent Block carries into the next round instead of resetting.

grapnel_clamp.name: Grapnel Clamp
grapnel_clamp.text: Reaching a weak point, you are never bucked off it.

safety_line.name: Safety Line
safety_line.text: Losing your grip drops you to the nearest hold below instead of all the way to the base.

relay_baton.name: Relay Baton
relay_baton.text: Unspent Energy when you end your turn passes to your ally instead of being lost.

warlords_girdle.name: Warlord's Girdle
warlords_girdle.text: Your attacks deal +6 damage. -1 Energy each round.

bottomless_quiver.name: Bottomless Quiver
bottomless_quiver.text: Draw 3 more cards each turn. Your attacks deal -3 damage.

fortress_ward.name: Fortress Ward
fortress_ward.text: Start each round with 10 Block. Draw 1 fewer card each turn.

adrenal_surge.name: Adrenal Surge
adrenal_surge.text: +2 Energy each round. Start each round with 4 less Block.
